title: Zang International with Lynette Zang: Debt Market Risks: Zang and Manorino Warn of a
description:
Original video author: Zang International with Lynette Zang. Independent recap and commentary; no endorsement implied. Debt market risks anchor this recap of Zang International with Lynette Zang’s conversation with Greg Manorino. We begin with the channel’s systemic-lockup warning, then explain Manorino’s argument that policies lifting stocks are squeezing households. Next come his market-risk indicator claim, the link he draws between energy prices and bond yields, and his interpretation of Fed and Treasury intervention. We finish with his views on hard assets, Bitcoin, commodity-backed money and community support.

For entertainment and informational purposes only. This is not financial, legal, medical, or other professional advice. Consult a qualified professional about your circumstances. We are not responsible for decisions or results based on this video.
